notes.title: Hacking for Hermann 1.0.0+5
notes.content:
[h2]Feature[/h2]
[list]
[*] Adding a button to the main menu that opens the official H4H Discord server.
[/list]

[h2]Bugs[/h2]
[list]
[*] DPI Scaling: H4H is now dpi scaling aware and looks great on high scaling percentages.
[*] Typo: Fixed a typo which was reported by the awesome people on discord.
[/list]
